map.基于West Haven标准评估肝性脑病严重程度（I-IV级），辅助临床分级与治: Assess hepatic encephalopathy severity (grade I-IV) based on the West Haven criteria, aiding clinical grading and treatment decisions.

map.📖 查看「肝性脑病 West Haven 分级使用指南」: 📖 View the Hepatic Encephalopathy West Haven Grading Usage Guide
map.肝性脑病分级 0 至 IV：取意识、行为、认知、扑翼样震颤各项中最高级别；依次为: Hepatic encephalopathy grading 0 to IV: take the highest level among consciousness, behavior, cognition, and asterixis; in order grade 0 (MHE), grade I, grade II, grade III, grade IV (coma).
map.轻微认知障碍，嗜睡或失眠: Mild cognitive impairment, somnolence or insomnia
map.0级（轻微型/隐匿型肝性脑病，MHE）需心理测试（数字连接试验NCT-A/B、符: Grade 0 (minimal/occult hepatic encephalopathy, MHE) requires psychological tests (number connection test NCT-A/B, symbol digit pattern test) or neurophysiological examination for confirmation.
map.提示：West Haven分级是临床最常用标准。0级需特殊检测手段发现。血氨水平: Note: The West Haven grading is the most commonly used clinical standard. Grade 0 requires special testing to detect. Ammonia levels do not perfectly parallel the grade, but dynamic monitoring helps assess efficacy. Treatment centers on removing precipitants, with lactulose and rifaximin as first-line drugs. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：肝性脑病 West Haven 分级: 📚 Deep Dive: Hepatic Encephalopathy West Haven Grading
map.分级评估：由意识、行为、认知、扑翼样震颤取最高级定 HE 分级: Grading assessment: take the highest level among consciousness, behavior, cognition, and asterixis to determine the HE grade
map.治疗分层：I-II 级门诊/日间，III-IV 级住院 ICU: Treatment stratification: grade I-II outpatient/day care, grade III-IV hospitalization with ICU
map.诱因管理：识别并去除感染、出血、便秘、低钾等诱因: Precipitant management: identify and remove infection, bleeding, constipation, hypokalemia, and other precipitants
map.算法：意识状态、行为变化、认知/智力、扑翼样震颤各取 0~IV 级（0 正常、I: Algorithm: consciousness state, behavior change, cognition/intellect, and asterixis each take grade 0~IV (0 normal, I mild, II somnolent/abnormal behavior, III stuporous, IV coma); the highest of the four determines the HE grade. Grade 0 is minimal (MHE), grade I starts lactulose, grade II requires hospitalization, grade III needs ICU monitoring, grade IV needs intubation for airway protection.
map.例：意识 2 级（嗜睡）、行为 2 级（明显异常）、认知 2 级（定向障碍）、扑: Example: consciousness grade 2 (somnolent), behavior grade 2 (markedly abnormal), cognition grade 2 (disoriented), asterixis grade 2 (marked) → highest grade 2, grade II hepatic encephalopathy; hospitalization, lactulose enema + rifaximin, and correction of precipitants are advised. If consciousness grade 4 (coma) and the rest grade 1 → highest grade 4, grade IV (coma), critical, requiring ICU, intubation, and urgent liver transplant evaluation.
map.轻微型肝性脑病实验室/影像正常，但心理与神经生理测试异常，影响生活质量与驾驶安全: Minimal hepatic encephalopathy has normal labs and imaging, but psychological and neurophysiological tests are abnormal, affecting quality of life and driving safety. Oral lactulose is advised (target 2~3 soft stools/day) with periodic assessment; most cases can be managed as outpatients.
map.乳果糖在结肠被细菌酵解产酸，使肠腔 pH 下降、氨以 NH₄⁺ 形式被截留并随粪: Lactulose is fermented by colonic bacteria to produce acid, lowering luminal pH so ammonia is trapped as NH₄⁺ and excreted in stool, while also promoting defecation to reduce ammonia absorption; it is foundational therapy for HE at all stages.
